(\textbf{tirar}.) To hold? (\textbf{segurar}.) To break; to leave? (\textbf{partir}.) To taste; to prove? (\textbf{provar}.) To rescue? (\textbf{salvar}.) To be born? (\textbf{nascer}.) To die? (\textbf{morrer}.) To grow old? (\textbf{envelhecer}.) To marry? (\textbf{casar}.) To cross? (\textbf{atravessar}.) To increase? (\textbf{aumentar}.) To decrease? (\textbf{diminuir}.) To warn?
